lines: One boss. One *decision* in a meeting you're not in.
#And if that decision goes the wrong way?
It means don't put your *whole* life in one basket.
#Build a skill people will pay for *outside* of work.
Teach what you know. Fix what you're good at *fixing.*
Let your savings slowly grow *on the side.*
#Your second income doesn't need to be *big.*
Because the day you have a second source, you stop living in *fear.*
#You go to work because you *choose* to.
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.
